info.title: X posts, mentions and recent search
info.description: Six operations of the X API v2 a person's token calls, kept whole from X's published OpenAPI document, version 2.173, read on 2026-10-30: who the person is, creating, editing and deleting a post as them, a user's posts and mentions, and the search of the last seven days, with an oauth2 scheme in place of the vendor's.

get.description: Retrieves details of the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new Post for the authenticated user, or edits an existing Post when edit_options are provided. Supports paid partnership disclosure via the paid_partnership field.

delete.description: Deletes a specific Post by its ID, if owned by the authenticated user.

get.description:
Retrieves a list of Posts authored by a specific User by their ID.

When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`. When both are provided, `since_id` must be less than `until_id`.

Retrieves a list of Posts that mention a specific User by their ID.

When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`. When both are provided, `since_id` must be less than `until_id`.

Retrieves Posts from the last 7 days matching a search query.

At most one of `start_time`, `since_id` may be provided. At most one of `end_time`, `until_id` may be provided. At most one of `pagination_token`, `next_token` may be provided.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Must be within the last 7 days.
